highlights.title: Meta Strategy Chief Dave Wehner to Become Fireworks CFO
highlights.description: Meta Platform’s chief strategy officer Dave Wehner is leaving the company to become chief finance officer of AI inference startup Fireworks, Wehner confirmed Friday. Wehner joined Facebook in 2012 as vice president of corporate finance and business planning and became CFO in 2014, a role he held ...

highlights.title: Amazon set to deploy more than 3,000 TATA electric delivery trucks
highlights.description: Amazon isn’t just electrifying its American delivery operations. The virtual big box stores that Bezos built understands the benefits of EVs as well as anyone, and they’re working hard to deploy electric vehicles everywhere they can. And now, that global push is extending to India. more…

highlights.title: SpaceX launches mystery mission for US Space Force in gorgeous sunset liftoff from California (photos)
highlights.description: SpaceX launched a classified mission for the U.S. Space Force from California this evening (Nov. 6). It was the company's 125th liftoff of 2026.
